{{Current events|year=2026|month=02|day=26|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
* [[2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan war]]
** [[Afghanistan]] announces attacks against [[Pakistan]]i [[Pakistan Armed Forces|military]] positions along [[Durand Line|their shared border]] in response to Pakistani [[2026 Pakistani airstrikes in Afghanistan|air strikes launched 4 days prior]]. Pakistan, in turn, says its forces have responded. [https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2026/2/26/afghanistan-says-it-launches-attacks-against-pakistan (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Zona da Mata floods]]
**The death toll from the [[flood]]s across [[Minas Gerais]], [[Brazil]], rises to 54 people, with fourteen more still missing. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260226-more-rain-lashes-southeast-brazil-as-death-toll-hits-54  (AFP via France 24)]
*Seven people are killed and 25 others are injured after a gas cylinder explodes inside a house in [[Chaman]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://dailytimes.com.pk/1457031/gas-cylinder-blast-kills-seven-in-chaman-home/ (Daily Times)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Greek surveillance scandal]]
**A [[Greece|Greek]] [[Judiciary of Greece|court]] sentences four individuals, including [[Intellexa]]'s [[Israel]]-based founder [[Tal Dilian]], to eight years in prison for [[Data breach|breaching data]] and violating [[Access to public information in Greece|privacy laws]] after they deployed the [[Predator (spyware)|Predator]] [[spyware]], targeting the mobile phones of more than 90 [[Politics of Greece|politicians]], [[Mass media in Greece|journalists]], [[Economy of Greece|businesspeople]], and [[Hellenic Armed Forces|military]] officials in 2022. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/greek-spyware-scandal-suspects-including-two-israelis-get-8-year-jail-terms/ (AFP via ''Times of Israel'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
* [[2026 Gorton and Denton by-election]]
**[[Green Party of England and Wales|Green Party]] candidate [[Hannah Spencer]] wins the [[United Kingdom constituencies|constituency]] of [[Gorton and Denton]] in [[Greater Manchester]], [[England]], in the party's first [[UK parliamentary by-elections|by-election]] win. [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/02/26/world/europe/gorton-denton-result-green-party-labour.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2026/02/26/uk-election-starmer-labour-reform-greens-gorton/70361f42-12f7-11f1-8e8d-fe91db44677b_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
* [[2026 Danish general election]]
**[[Denmark|Danish]] [[Prime Minister of Denmark|prime minister]] [[Mette Frederiksen]] calls a [[snap election]] for March 24 amid the [[Greenland crisis]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/world/europe/denmark-calls-early-election-tense-us-greenland-standoff-rcna260824 (AP via NBC News)]
*[[Corruption in Albania]]
**[[Albania]]n [[Prime Minister of Albania|prime minister]] [[Edi Rama]] dismisses [[Deputy Prime Minister of Albania|deputy prime minister]] and [[Ministry of Infrastructure and Energy (Albania)|infrastructure minister]] [[Belinda Balluku]] after anti-corruption prosecutors indicted her on suspicion of interfering in the award of two [[Government procurement|public]] [[construction contract]]s worth more than €200 million. [https://www.reuters.com/world/albanian-pm-fires-deputy-corruption-investigation-heats-up-2026-02-26/ (Reuters)]
